title: Heatmap
description: A grid of one measure across two dimensions, shaded from light (low) to dark (high), with empty cells kept visible as gaps.
x-use-when: One measure cross-tabbed by two dimensions: margin by manufacturer and quarter, orders by branch and item class, revenue by rep and KPA. Missing cells stay visible as gaps.
x-dont-use-when: There is only one dimension (use bar_chart), the columns are a long time series for a few rows (use line_chart), or the user needs records with mixed fields (use table).
x-checks: Error when values doesn't have one row per row label, or a row doesn't have one value per column label.
Error when two row labels or two column labels are the same.
Warns when percent values look like whole numbers (45 instead of 0.45).
Warns when every cell is null.
Warns when more than 12 columns are shown at a size smaller than full.

row_labels.description: Labels down the left side, in display order, e.g. manufacturers sorted by revenue.

column_labels.description: Labels across the top, in display order. Keep periods in time order, oldest first.

values.description: One list per row label, each with one raw number per column label: values[row][column]. Use null for a missing or withheld cell, never 0.

format.description: How cell values are displayed. percent expects fractions: 0.124 shows as 12.4%.

row_header.description: Header above the row labels, e.g. "Manufacturer".

show_values.description: Print the value in each cell. Turn off only for large grids where the shading alone tells the story.
